reason: Between the café and the scooters I get a flood of receipts in Telegram and I've already caught someone double-claiming, so a sheet that flags duplicates and wrong totals is exactly what I check by hand now. The rows sit in my own Google Sheet, so if they shut down I keep everything. I'd burn the 30 free in a week, test it hard, then pay the $19 tier.
objection: My mechanics get paid cash against scribbled handwritten notes. Can it read those properly, and will it catch a padded amount or only an exact duplicate? And is this little bot still going to be here next year?
would_change_my_mind: If it gets amounts wrong on the free 30 or misses a duplicate I send on purpose to test it, I'm out and I go back to checking by hand.
